spiritual_reading:
# Spiritual
 Translation


**
¶1:**
 Now
 as to what pert
ains to wisdom
:
 at
 the beginning, fals
ity was strong against it and
 pressed
 upon it with
 its
 whole
 force
. Yet
 no contradiction
 or
 division
 exists
 within
 wisdom
 itself
,
 for all truths that
 proceed
 from the Divine co
here in perfect
 unity.

**¶2:**
 The wisdom
 that proceeds
 forth
 from the Divine dw
ells
 in its
 own full
ness,
 and every
 form of that
 wisdom exists in mutual accord
 with every
 other,
 etern
ally. Not
 one truth
 within
 it
 transg
resses the order
 and
 law
 that its
 neighboring
 truth
 has established
,
 for in
 divine
 order each
 truth sust
ains and confirms
 every
 other truth
 without
 end
.

**¶3:** However
, falsity —
 the advers
ary — was dest
ined from
 the beginning to per
ish, because
 it
 is
 overcome
 by its
 own nature
. Through
 the arising of internal
 contradiction
, falsity was divided against
 itself.
 Even its
 organized
 state
 of
 mind
 was divided within itself; and even those
 fac
ulties of
 evil that had
 risen up
 out
 of the deepest obsc
urity of
 ignor
ance,
 following
 after
 falsity into
 activity, were destined to fail
 because
 of the contradiction
 present
 in all of them.
 Falsity was broken
 apart
 by
 its own in
coherence,
 and its subordin
ate powers were brought
 to
 nothing
.

**¶4:** So
 long as the
 interior
 goods that
 share
 in the hidden
 things
 of wisdom
 are in harmony
 with one
 another, that
 spiritual
 state
 stands
 firm and is perceived
 with
 wonder
, and divine
 truth is made
 manifest in glory
. That
 state
 sur
passes and is ex
alted above the
 opposing state of evil that
 is gathering
 itself
 to
 rise
 against it.

**¶5
:** Nevertheless
, the
 spiritual state whose
 interior
 goods are united
 in wisdom
 is compelled by
 its
 very
 nature to judge
 and
 condemn that opposing
 state of fals
ity. And the
 powers
 of
 falsity are brought
 low
 and fall
 under the domin
ion of wisdom that is established
 against them —
 for
 what
 is self
-contrad
icting
 cannot
 endure before
 what
 is one
.

reconstructions.reconstructed_text: [Now as to what affects the] Light, behold, at the beginning the Darkness was strong against it; [and it pressed upon it with all its force. Yet] no disunity [or division] exists in the Light.

[Behold and
 consider] how far [and wide is
 the lig]ht that came
 forth from [the Father; it ab
ides] in that place in a [
unity] alone [. All share in
] the greatness of the Light with
 one another for ever, and nor did
 one of them transgress the command and
 order that his brother had entrusted
 to him forever.

However, the Darkness, the enemy, was doomed and overcome; because of the arising of disharmony it was divided within itself. Even the kingdom was divided within itself; [and] ev[en] the [powers, who had] left their abyss behind and come up fo[llow-ing] it, were doomed because of the disunity that was present in all of them. The Darkness was destroyed, and its other powers were humiliated,
